title: Leader of the Opposition Privileges Act 1965

sections.shortTitle: Leader of the Opposition Privileges Act 1965
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

THE LEADER OF THE OPPOSITION (PRIVILEGES)
THE LEADER OF THE
OPPOSITION (PRIVILEGES)
ACT, 1965.
ACT No. XIII of
1965
(For Statement of Objects and Reasons, see Gaz. of P., 1965,
Ext., p 656.)
[12th August,
1965]
An Act to provide
for certain privileges of the Leader of the Opposition in the National
Assembly.
1. Short title and
commencement------(1) This Act may be called the Leader of the Opposi tion
(Privileges) Act, 1965.
(2) It shall come into force on
the 15th day of August, 1965.

sections.shortTitle: Leader of the Opposition Privileges Act 1965
sections.description:
Definition

THE LEADER OF THE OPPOSITION (PRIVILEGES)
THE LEADER OF THE
OPPOSITION (PRIVILEGES)
ACT, 1965.
ACT No. XIII of
1965
(For Statement of Objects and Reasons, see Gaz. of P., 1965,
Ext., p 656.)
[12th August,
1965]
An Act to provide
for certain privileges of the Leader of the Opposition in the National
Assembly.
2. Definition-----In this
Act, unless there is anything repugnant in the sub ject or context, "
Leader of the Opposition " means that member of the National Assembly who,
in the opinion of the President, is for the time being the Leader in that
Assembly of the party in opposition to the Government having the greatest
numerical strength in that Assembly.

sections.shortTitle: Leader of the Opposition Privileges Act 1965
sections.description:
Honorarium of the Leader of the Opposition

THE LEADER OF THE OPPOSITION (PRIVILEGES)
THE LEADER OF THE
OPPOSITION (PRIVILEGES)
ACT, 1965.
ACT No. XIII of
1965
(For Statement of Objects and Reasons, see Gaz. of P., 1965,
Ext., p 656.)
[12th August,
1965]
An Act to provide
for certain privileges of the Leader of the Opposition in the National
Assembly.
3. Honorarium of the Leader of
the Opposition------The Leader of the Opposition shall receive an honorar ium
of two thousand rupees per mensem and be entitled to such other privileges as
may be prescribed by the Central Government.

sections.shortTitle: Leader of the Opposition Privileges Act 1965
sections.description:
Office not to disqualify for membership of an Assembly

THE LEADER OF THE OPPOSITION (PRIVILEGES)
THE LEADER OF THE
OPPOSITION (PRIVILEGES)
ACT, 1965.
ACT No. XIII of
1965
(For Statement of Objects and Reasons, see Gaz. of P., 1965,
Ext., p 656.)
[12th August,
1965]
An Act to provide
for certain privileges of the Leader of the Opposition in the National
Assembly.
4. Office not to disqualify
for membership of an Assembly----It is hereby declared that the office of
the Leader of the Opposition shall not disqualify, and shall be deemed never to
have disqualified, its holder from being elected as, or from being, a member of
an Assembly.
